title: Toward Foundation Models for Earth Monitoring: Proposal for a Climate Change Benchmark

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating distribution shifts by partitioning dataset train, validation, and test sets based on geographic metadata (e.g., country), and assessing disparities in global satellite data coverage and resolution across different regions.
Evaluating performance under distribution shifts by partitioning datasets based on temporal metadata (e.g., date or season).

Qualitatively assessing fairness and accessibility issues stemming from the high financial cost of acquiring high-resolution, on-demand satellite imagery, which can limit data access for less-economically developed regions.
